PHYSIOLOGY.Definition: how the bodies of living things work

GOLDEN ERA.Definition: the best and most successful period

STATUS QUO.Definition: the way things are now; the existing situation

CLASSIFIED.Definition: named and put into a scientific group

DISMISSED.Definition: rejected as not worth thinking about

BENEFIT OF THE DOUBT.Definition: the chance to be believed, even without proof

IN SHORT.Definition: to summarise; in a few words

AMATEURS.Definition: people who do something as a hobby, without training or pay

SUPPOSED.Definition: said to be genuine but doubtful

MODELS.Definition: computer or mathematical systems used to predict what will happen

EXTINCT.Definition: completely gone, with none left alive
